explanation: This test only verifies that the wallet balance increases after a top-up of SGD 500. It does not verify that the FX rate is locked at the moment of initiation (fx_lock), nor does it verify that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited (credit_before_debit). It also does not test the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval). The test misses assertions to check the FX rate lock, the order of credit and debit operations, and the approval workflow for large top-ups.
missingAssertions: Verify FX rate is locked at top-up initiation
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Verify top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the FX rate is not locked at initiation and fluctuates during processing would not be caught. Also, a bug where the funding source is debited before the wallet is credited would not be detected. Additionally, a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 do not require second-owner approval would be missed.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify wallet top-up with FX rate lock, credit-before-debit, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Verify FX rate is locked at the moment of initiation
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Check wallet balance increases by SGD 500
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Check wallet balance increases by SGD 15,000
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement; wallet balance increases accordingly
